description: PreToolUse on Edit, Write and Bash is xtask permit over the hook's stdin (harness-design.md §4.4); the built binary is a process start, cargo run the fallback when none is built, about 200 ms more. Stop is xtask done --hook over the hook's stdin (§4.5): the turn is held with the unmet list as the reason, and the second Stop, stop_hook_active true, passes; it goes through cargo run, since what a turn changes is often xtask itself, and a cargo that fails is a block naming the build, never a silent pass, except on the second Stop. SessionStart on startup, resume, clear and compact points core.hooksPath at scripts/hooks when the clone has none, so pre-push is wired, then renders the local file and prints the map plus the local facts (§5); once a session, so it goes through cargo run, which rebuilds a stale binary rather than trusting it.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && for x in target/release/xtask target/debug/xtask; do [ -x "$x" ] && exec "$x" permit; done; exec cargo run -q -p xtask -- permit

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && in=$(cat) && { printf '%s' "$in" | cargo run -q -p xtask -- done --hook || case $in in *'"stop_hook_active":true'*) ;; *) echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"xtask done did not run: cargo run -q -p xtask -- done --hook failed; fix the build of xtask"}';; esac; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ -n "$(git config core.hooksPath)" ] || git config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks; X='cargo run -q -p xtask --'; [ -f .claude/harness.local.md ] || $X status --session >/dev/null; computed run .claude/harness.local.md >/dev/null 2>&1; case $? in 0|1) ;; 2) echo 'harness: a marker in .claude/harness.local.md is broken; see `computed check .claude/harness.local.md`';; *) echo 'harness: computed did not run; the local facts are stale (cargo install computed)';; esac; exec $X status --session
